# Receipt image fixtures

All `receipt-*` images here are **synthetic** and contain no real customer data. They are not valid tax invoices or physical iPhone captures.

- `receipt-th-en.png`: Thai/English receipt, 1000×1200, generated by `scripts/make-receipt-fixture.ps1`. Coffee 80 + Lunch 70 + VAT 10.50 = THB 160.50; cash 200 and change 39.50 are not expenses.
- `receipt-th-en.heic`: same receipt as HEIF/HEVC.
- `receipt-exif6.jpg`: stored sideways with EXIF orientation 6; display must be 1000×1200.
- `receipt-rotated.heic`: HEIF container rotation (`irot`), not merely a descriptive EXIF field; display must be 1000×1200.
- `receipt-24mp.heic`: synthetic 4000×6000 source to exercise bounded downscaling.

Regenerate variants using Python with Pillow 12.1.0 and pillow-heif 1.3.0:

```text
python scripts/make-iphone-receipt-fixtures.py
```

These libraries are development-only; the shipped app uses its native host adapters. Real iPhone HDR, auxiliary gain/depth images, 10-bit variants and OEM camera/provider behavior need additional device fixtures.
